import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Format a log line as '[level] message' and print it to console output."""
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_info(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "System ready")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] System ready\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_error(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "Failed to connect")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[ERROR] Failed to connect\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_custom_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("debug", "cache miss for key: foo")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[debug] cache miss for key: foo\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[WARN] \n"
    assert captured.err == ""
